title: Passwords inside connection strings: one-property twin (context)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: the userinfo password colon is absent while the value is unchanged. Twin of "Passwords inside connection strings: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of connection-string-postgres-userinfo: context: the userinfo password colon is absent while the value is unchanged. The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
